body:
Evan C.: Hi team, just unboxed my MacBook and during setup the MDM enrollment failed with 'Device already enrolled in another organization' and FileVault started and shows a personal recovery key prompt. Intro sync in 20m, worried about encrypting with a personal key. Help?

IT Support: Hey Evan, welcome! That message usually means the serial is still claimed in our DEP by a previous return. Important: do NOT accept any personal recovery key or finish manual FileVault enablement until we confirm. Can you paste the serial from `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep 'Serial'`?

Evan C.: Serial: C02ZXY9PQ2T9. I'm on macOS 14.6. I haven't entered any personal recovery key yet; it shows the option but I declined.

Maya (Onboarding): Thanks  we're seeing a small batch of units with stale claims. IT, can you check C02ZXY9PQ2T9 and unclaim?

IT Support: Checking DEP... yep, shows as claimed/returned. We'll unclaim and reassign to new-hires now. ETA ~10m. In the meantime, if you need to join the call we'll provision a temporary local admin (24h). If you prefer, you can join from your personal laptop via Zoom.

Evan C.: Please create the temp admin, I'll use it to join. Also, if I later enable FileVault while on the temp admin, will that create a personal key?

Alex D: Quick answer  yes, if you enable FileVault before enrollment the system may prompt to create a personal recovery key which isn't escrowed to our MDM. So avoid enabling it on the temp account. We'll confirm enrollment first, then enable FileVault under your SSO user so the recovery key gets escrowed.

IT Support: Creating temp admin now. Run this one-liner in Terminal: `sudo sysadminctl -addUser temp_evan -fullName "Temp Evan" -password "RdTmp!2026" -admin` then log out and sign in as temp_evan. We'll remove the account after 24h.

Evan C.: Done, I'm in as temp_evan and can join the call. Thanks.

IT Support: DEP unclaim and reassign complete. Reboot and sign in with your corp SSO (not temp_evan). After SSO login check System Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault. If enrollment worked you should see 'Your recovery key will be saved to your organization's management system'.

Evan C.: Rebooted, signed in with SSO. Got the exact message and FileVault is now enabling. :tada:

Maya (Onboarding): Welcome to Redwood Inference! We'll remove temp_evan later today. Evan, if you see any kernel extension or notarization prompts while installing dev tools, screenshot them here.

onboarding-bot: Device C02ZXY9PQ2T9 reassigned to new-hires and enrollment completed. Temporary account temp_evan scheduled for deletion in 24h. Welcome to Redwood Inference!
